last_quiz.subject: ENGLISH
last_quiz.question: Select the sentence in which the verb tense is used incorrectly.

options.A: She has been working here since five years.
options.B: If he had known, he would have come earlier.
options.C: They were watching a movie when the power went out.
options.D: I will finish the report by tomorrow.

last_quiz.explanation: "Since" requires a point in time; the correct phrase is "for five years". Hence option A is incorrect.
